datePolicy: All original source accesses retain November 6, 2026 Asia/Singapore; retrievals were late November 5 UTC and in Cape Town. ECB rate is dated November 5, 2026. Local drafting, arithmetic and retained-evidence checks on November 6 are not an external source refresh. No publication date or original model invented.
uncertainties: SANParks official numerical PDF blocked and not inspected. Cape Point attraction displays R595 versus reported R592; higher R595 is budgeted. Boulders R282 remains secondary-reported, not official-verified. The R1167 entry-included operator option implies R592 but does not settle the gate tariff.

February hotel availability, full room/tax/breakfast bill, deposits/cancellation and tour prices/seats/line are unconfirmed. Cheviot calendar is November; Stadium high-season rates stop in December and one peak date row is malformed.

All transport times, airport margins, rides, rental, food, tastings, insurance and free-public-access allowances remain estimates. Rental comparison uses six billing periods, not five nights. Insurance is unquoted.

German-passport visa/eTA/customs and driving notes are dated retained guidance, not an eligibility promise or immigration advice. Passport validity calculation and border discretion preserved; yellow-fever transit route unknown.
Weather, cableway operation, swimming and individual safety cannot be guaranteed. Dated national no-loadshedding report is not a February or street-level power promise.
No live external research, publication, booking, contact, form submission, account creation or payment was performed. Source snapshots provide historical evidence, not current link reachability.
editingContract: Reader-first English and Simplified Chinese Markdown with schema v2 semantic data; strict whole-body, frontmatter and table-cell numeric/date/URL parity; local drafts only. Inventory, shared scripts, renderer and source run unchanged.

sourceGroundedAudit.scope: Local retained-source comparison and assigned-slug checks only; no external refresh, build, inventory edits or browser check.
sourceGroundedAudit.strictDraftCheck: check_i18n.parity('cape-town-five-day-road-trip') passed using the existing unmodified checker, including whole-body and frontmatter numbers/dates/URLs, corresponding table cells, source registry, locale metadata and headline displays.
sourceGroundedAudit.arithmetic: All original ZAR and individually rounded EUR rows match. Sum R29004 / EUR1574.01 at EUR1=R18.4268; remaining R478.88 / EUR25.99 to EUR1600. Inclusive Peninsula option computes to R2898 versus conservative R2904 baseline; not a tariff resolution.
consequentialCoverage: Original Frankfurt/two-adult/German-passport profile, five nights and six dated day plans; first mountain window and Wednesday backup, windy beach alternatives, departure buffer and bag collection.

Complete budget and exclusions, meals/breakfast assumption, unquoted insurance, hotel date limitations and higher-room-price sensitivity; no double counting of park-inclusive coach or tram-inclusive package.
Peninsula route and estimated segment times, international gates and cash-free proof rules, R592/R595 discrepancy, higher Cape Point allowance and secondary Boulders fee beside costs.
Wine coach/line/estate limitations, tastings, return timetable, late Uber caution; retained snapshot also supports onboard tasting and selected-date-only ticket validity.

Rental six billing periods, left-side driving, fuel/parking, IDP plus German licence, card/deposit/excess; official airport routing, ride checks, group hiking, swimming and emergency precautions calmly retained.

German visa exemption, passport pages/validity calculation, border discretion, eTA status, separate customs declaration for entry and exit, yellow-fever-route caveat; dated national electricity statement not treated as future or local guarantee.
adjacentSourceFindings: peninsula.txt displays R1167 including Cape Point entry; its R592 uplift supports retaining, not resolving, the original discrepancy. New prose gives this alternative without changing the conservative baseline.

wine-tour.txt includes tram onboard tasting but excludes estate tastings; advance booking and chosen-day validity are explicit. These details were absent from the source itinerary and are now visible.

cheviot.txt exposes 50–100% deposits and 14-day full-forfeiture wording alongside a 28-day free-cancellation headline; readers must obtain the full applicable schedule. Stadium's 50% deposit, limited Wi-Fi and conditional tandem parking levy are also visible.
